display.title: T1: Shafts & Cogwheels
display.subtitle: The parts every Create machine needs
description: Before machines come the §bcomponents§r. Andesite Alloy presses into
§bShafts§r, and shafts cap with planks into §bCogwheels§r and §bLarge
Cogwheels§r - the gears that carry rotational force across a contraption.
Craft a working stock of cogwheels to complete this beat. Large cogwheels
gear rotation up or down to hit the speed each machine wants.
§7Shafts and cogwheels are the connective tissue of every Tier 1 build.
